say: Sometimes the cause behind your incident is bigger, and the service desk opens a problem to remove it.

c: Your incident shows On Hold. You keep your number and don't need to do anything.
say: Your incident shows on hold, waiting for the problem. You keep your number, and you don't need to do anything.

c: When the fix is in, your incident is resolved by itself and you get the usual email.
say: When the fix is in, your incident is resolved by itself, and you get the usual email.

c: A workaround reaches the support teams, not you. Ask on your incident.
say: Meanwhile, a workaround reaches the support teams, not you. If you need to keep working, ask on your incident.

c: If it still doesn't work, reopen it.
say: If it still doesn't work for you after the fix, reopen it as usual.
